name: Guangdong Yowant Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Yowant Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the digital marketing business in China. It offers social e-commerce, new media advertising, self-operated brands and distribution, and apparel and footwear, as well as internet marketing. The company also sells fashion leather shoes, apparel; and the wholesale and retail of various fashion products. In addition, it offers its products under the ST&SAT men, D:FUSE, SAFIYA, SATURDAYMODE, and FONDBERYL brand names. The company was formerly known as Foshan Yowant Technology Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Guangdong Yowant Technology Group Co., Ltd. in August 2025.
